messages:
jordan: noticed interactive heatmap lagging badly on canary after today’s console roll. LCP up ~800ms, sparkline frameskip. Anyone else seeing this?
morgan: yep saw it on /dash/monitoring — charts hang ~1.2s when panning
eli: looks like kv cache miss spike in CDN logs? saw many requests to /assets/chunk-heatmap-*.js and repeated 200s but no cache hits
sasha: rollout 11:42am included a new splitpoint for heatmap renderer and a small sourcemap helper; possible chunk id churn
deploy-bot: deploy finished by @sasha at 2026-03-21 11:42 UTC — canary rollout to 10% :white_check_mark:
jordan: profiler snapshot shows main thread blocked on parsing a big vendor chunk and subsequent inflate work — suspect chunk got much larger
jordan: paste logs:
```
NetworkResourceLoader: fetched chunk-heatmap.2f3a.js (4.8MB)
ParseTime: 980ms
KVCache: miss route=eu-west count=187
```
tim: FYI KV routing weights were tweaked in the policy PR (routing-policy: prefer eu with low TTL). That increases cross-region misses if affinity is low
eli: also saw backend telemetry: `prefetch=false` header showing up from some clients — looks like prefetch hints not being emitted for this splitpoint
sasha: I reverted that splitpoint locally and heatmap load returns to normal in dev — seems likely size + missing preload is causing the stall
morgan: can we hotfix by reintroducing `link rel=preload` and reduce the split? quick patch for canary rollback ok
ops-bot: Rollout alert: canary 10% has elevated LCP metrics and increased main-thread parse time -> rollback recommended :warning:
jordan: propose quick rollback to previous canary and follow-up ticket: prefetchtuning + chunk-size rollback + routing affinity audit
sasha: cutting rollback patch now, will include preload and revert splitpoint change in separate PR
eli: adding telemetry checks: alert if `prefetch` header present=false or kv-hit-rate < 90% for 5m windows
tim: note for changelog: avoid touching routing weights and splitpoints together — makes perf bisecting painful
morgan: :thumbsup:
jordan: post-rollback quick check shows canary LCP down ~350ms, sparkline smooth again — monitoring continuing
sasha: rollback completed at 2026-03-21 11:58 UTC
deploy-bot: rollback completed by @sasha at 2026-03-21 11:58 UTC — canary reverted to previous artifact
jordan: closing for now, created PERF-heatmap-chunk-eviction with repro steps and perf test plan
eli: will add a telemetry regression test to CI to catch this class of regression
morgan: adding a note to run chunk-size budget review in next sprint
jordan: thanks all, reopening if the LCP creeps back up
